component.name: HomeDeck
component.summary: Home control panel for Home Assistant, IoT and network devices, and cameras

description.p: HomeDeck connects to Home Assistant, to IoT devices directly (MQTT, Philips Hue), to plain network devices that are not smart at all, and to security cameras of any brand (ONVIF, RTSP).
Its voice assistant answers to a wake name you choose and is fully offline: a deterministic on-device grammar, no cloud round-trip.
